The ocean’s thunderous voice, a powerful roar  
Resonates through the mountains surrounding it  
Its waves, a wild and untamed force  
Battering the coastline, a breathtaking spectacle  

The tides rise and fall  
A steady rhythm of ebb and flow, unceasing  
The ocean’s power, a marvel to witness  
A testament to strength, ancient and unyielding  

In turbulent weather, it becomes fierce and magnificent  
The waves, towering and imposing.Humanity's journey through time  
A story written in stone and sky  
From ancient roots to modern days  
The world has evolved, and so have we  

Our progress, a path of growth and change  
Building bridges, shaping new ideas  
In every step, a spark of hope  
A vision of a better future, bright and clear  

The world, a vast and ever-changing place  
With challenges and wonders to explore  
We stand at the edge of a new era
